Aisha - CS: quick heads-up — prepping a short activation + renewal preflight to send to Acme. want a concise runbook with caching/batching/streaming tweaks and the key health signals.
Tom - Solutions: yes pls. include a tiny 'do this, don't do that' and a curl + SDK snippet. customers love copy-paste. :point_right:
Lina - Acme Corp: appreciate it. last week's incident: lots of single-turn calls, no batching, streaming off. cost spiked and p99 latency jumped.
Ravi - SRE: recommend adding objective signs of risk: token burn delta >25% week-over-week, p99 latency >800ms, cache hit <15%. map them to action items (prefetch, batch small requests, enable streaming).
Aisha - CS: ok first draft below — short, actionable, and customer-facing. keep it <1 page. edit suggestions welcome.
Aisha - CS: === Activation & Renewal Preflight: quick runbook ===
- Purpose: reduce tail latency and unit cost before renewal review; unblock common onboarding friction.
- When to run: onboarding window, after spike alerts, and 30/14/7 days before renewal call.
- Signals to check (automated where possible):
  - token_burn_rate (last7 / prev7) > 1.25 -> cost risk
  - p99_latency_ms > 800 -> UX risk
  - cache_hit_rate < 15% -> opportunity for prefetching
  - small_request_pct > 60% (requests < 64 tokens) -> batching candidate
- Quick fixes to propose to customer:
  1) Turn on streaming for interactive flows (reduces perceived latency): suggest enabling for routes where response length > 32 tokens.
  2) Enable simple request batching on SDK side for micro requests (batch window 50-200ms or group up to 8 items).
  3) Add prefix caching for common prompt templates with TTL 12h and soft-revalidate on updates.
  4) Review quantization/model variant for cost-sensitive endpoints (e.g., llama-2-13b -> quantized v2).
- Example recommended config (customer-ready snippet):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    { "name": "chat.interactive", "stream": true, "batching": { "enabled": true, "max_wait_ms": 75, "max_batch_size": 8 }, "cache": { "enabled": true, "ttl_seconds": 43200 } },
    { "name": "embed.small", "stream": false, "batching": { "enabled": true, "max_wait_ms": 150, "max_batch_size": 32 }, "cache": { "enabled": false } }
  ]
}
```
- Copy-paste check commands for support ticket (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checks/preflight -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"account_id": "acme-123"}'
```
Tom - Solutions: love the snippets. can we also add a one-line customer blurb for the renewal email?
Aisha - CS: added below: "We've identified a few quick optimizations (batching, streaming, and caching) that typically cut p99 latency in half and lower per-token cost — happy to walk through a <20m config change during our next call."
Lina - Acme Corp: that wording works for our execs. can you also include an item to measure before/after (baseline configs)?
Ravi - SRE: add two metrics to baseline template: average tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, and cache_hit_rate. include a small test script (below) to capture 1k samples.
Aisha - CS: adding test script snippet for baseline capture:
```bash

python3 capture_metrics.py --account acme-123 --samples 1000 --parallel 10
# outputs metrics.csv with tokens, latency_ms, timestamp
```
